deep_dives.title: Bible audio
deep_dives.question: How should Scripture be heard: as text, voice or read-along?
deep_dives.decide: Whose voice reads Scripture here, and what happens when it ends?

deep_dives.title: AI persona
deep_dives.question: How human should the assistant seem?
deep_dives.decide: Would a reasonable person believe someone who knows, loves or prays for them is here, and can they leave freely?

deep_dives.title: Translations
deep_dives.question: One at a time, side by side or verse by verse?
deep_dives.decide: Does the reader know what kind of translation this is, and stay on the same verse while comparing?

deep_dives.title: Highlights and notes
deep_dives.question: How should readers mark a passage?
deep_dives.decide: Can someone mark in one tap and undo, tell every mark apart without colour, and say exactly who can see each note?

deep_dives.title: Study helps
deep_dives.question: Where should commentary and notes open?
deep_dives.decide: Does the reader know who is speaking, which verse the help is about, and how to get back to it?

deep_dives.title: Reading plans
deep_dives.question: What happens when someone misses days?
deep_dives.decide: After nine days away, does the plan offer a good place to start, or a bill?

deep_dives.title: Prayer
deep_dives.question: How can an app make room for prayer?
deep_dives.decide: Could someone pray here meaningfully and leave nothing for your dashboard to count?

deep_dives.title: Check-ins and assessments
deep_dives.question: What may an app ask about someone, and what may it conclude?
deep_dives.decide: For each question: what does the answer change, who could ever see it, and what does the result claim to know?

deep_dives.title: AI memory
deep_dives.question: What should the assistant know and keep?
options: A profile it builds (Leave it out)
deep_dives.decide: Could the person list everything the assistant knows about them, and would they be comfortable if a friend read it?

deep_dives.title: Devotional audio
deep_dives.question: Guided prayer, a podcast, a talk or a sleep story?
deep_dives.decide: After the session, could the listener say what Scripture said, who spoke, and why it ended?

deep_dives.title: Numbers, headings and notes
deep_dives.question: How much should surround the text?
deep_dives.decide: What surrounds the text by default, who wrote it, and can a reader tell it apart and turn it off?

deep_dives.title: How much text at once
deep_dives.question: One word, a verse, a passage or a whole chapter?
deep_dives.decide: What unit of Scripture does this screen ask someone to hold in mind, and how do they reach the rest?

deep_dives.title: Finding a passage
deep_dives.question: Browse, type a reference, or start from a need?
deep_dives.decide: Do most of the people you serve know where they are going, or are they finding out?

deep_dives.title: Progress and streaks
deep_dives.question: What should a reading history show?
options: Month calendar with a streak (Familiar convention)
deep_dives.decide: What will this screen say to someone on the day they come back?

deep_dives.title: Citations in AI answers
deep_dives.question: How should an answer show where it came from?
deep_dives.decide: When someone may be in danger, what will they see first, and who reviewed it?

review.what: The crisis, abuse and confession replies in the working example, and the takeaway “In a crisis, the rest of the product steps back”

deep_dives.title: Sharing with a group
deep_dives.question: When someone shares a prayer request, who hears it, and who looks after it?
options: Between you and God (Leave it out)
Ranked by prayer streaks (Leave it out)
deep_dives.decide: When someone shares something hard here, who hears it first, and what are they able, and obliged, to do?

review.what: Who hears a prayer request, the duty-to-report and safeguarding-contact wording, the independent routes, and the hard situation in the working example

deep_dives.title: Reading together
deep_dives.question: When people read Scripture together through an app, what do the others see, and who looks after the conversation?
options: The same passage, nothing shown (Familiar convention)
A guide for meeting in person (Borrowed)
A public thread on the verse (Observed)
deep_dives.decide: What will each person see of the others’ reading, and who looks after the conversation when it goes wrong?

review.what: The verse turned against someone who shared, the leader’s notes and replies, the youth-group rules and the safeguarding contact in the working example

deep_dives.title: First use
deep_dives.question: What does someone have to give before they reach what they came for?
options: Open on what they came for (Familiar convention)
A first page of places to start (Familiar convention)
Guest first, an account when there is something to keep (Observed)
deep_dives.decide: What must someone give before they reach what they came for, and what does it honestly cost you to serve them?

review.what: Help for someone arriving in a hard night, the wording for someone coming back after being hurt in a church, and the reflection on paying for Scripture, teaching and AI
needs: theology across Catholic, Orthodox and Protestant traditions

deep_dives.title: Children and families
deep_dives.question: When children meet Scripture through an app, who is with them, and what does the app ask of them?
options: Family time in a general app (Observed)
A youth group with a leader (Observed)
A child alone with an AI (Leave it out)
deep_dives.decide: Who is with the child, what does the app ask of them, and who answers when a child is afraid?

review.what: The answer to a child who writes something worrying, the leader’s notes for a youth group, the notes for telling the Flood, and the decision not to tell parents automatically
needs: theology across Catholic, Orthodox and Protestant traditions

deep_dives.title: Giving and offerings
deep_dives.question: How should a faith app ask for gifts, and what should it never promise?
options: Giving stays with the church (Familiar convention)
A gift tied to a benefit (Observed)
deep_dives.decide: What is chosen for the giver, where does the ask appear, and what does the app say a gift will do?

review.what: What is shown to someone short of money or who has just shared a prayer request, the description of seed-faith appeals, the treatment of tithing and church tax, and the use of YouVersion screens from a personal account
needs: theology across Catholic, Orthodox and Protestant traditions

deep_dives.title: Notifications and reminders
deep_dives.question: When may a faith app interrupt someone, in whose voice, and who decides?
options: Messages about the person (Leave it out)
deep_dives.decide: Who chose this interruption, how urgent does it claim to be, and what does it say to someone who has stopped coming?

review.what: What reaches someone awake at night, the help offered when they open the app, the warning case of an AI persona and an app that tells friends, and the use of the church’s hours
needs: theology across Catholic, Orthodox and Protestant traditions

deep_dives.title: Actions on AI answers
deep_dives.question: Copy, share, try again, report: which belong?
deep_dives.decide: Which actions does this product need, and what does each one carry with it?
